## Constraints

- An ADR is not a path into implementation
- Implementation still requires an approved plan

## Validate

<pre><code>backstop artifact validate --adr ADR-NNNN</code></pre>

## Reviewer

ADRs do not have a dedicated reviewer agent.

- The validator checks the schema and required sections

## Notes

An ADR records why a decision was made. Later specs and plans can cite it.

Product code is not written from the ADR.
